en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Suleyman Bin Muhammad Al Khash’amy, from Ishaq Al Taweel Al Attar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to spend regarding the perfume more than what he<sup>saww</sup> used to spend regarding the food’.
en.sarwar: 18. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Sulayman from Muhammad al-Khath’amiy from Ishaq al- Tawil al-‘ Altar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, spent more on perfumes than his spending on food.”
